recipes.name: Strawberry Milk Bubble Tea
instructions: To a saucepan, add the frozen strawberries and sugar. Cook over medium heat until the strawberries have thawed. Use the back of a spoon to lightly mash the strawberries.
Remove the pan from the stove and use an immersion blender or standing blender to purée the strawberries. Set aside to cool.
Cook the tapioca pearls according to the package instructions. For us, this took 5 minutes.
Drain the tapioca pearls, and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process. Add the pearls to a bowl and mix in the agave syrup.
In a pitcher, combine the oat milk, whipping cream, and vanilla.
Divide the tapioca pearls between your glasses, and spoon some of the strawberry purée over the pearls.
Top with ice, followed by the vanilla cream milk. Finish with some fresh strawberries if desired. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium .

Storage This bubble tea is best enjoyed immediately. The strawberry purée can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 1 day. The vanilla cream milk can be stored in the fridge for up to 3 days.
